# POLISH-1 experience correction — reconciled stage1 batch

Implement the bounded follow-up to [OS1-01–08](../reviews/OPUS-STAGE1-R1.md), under [root disposition](../reviews/OPUS-STAGE1-R1-DISPOSITION.md). Opus's [implementation advice](../design/OPUS-STAGE1-IMPLEMENTATION.md), commit7d0e635, is integrated as advice only. This document resolves its open choices and supersedes conflicting proposal details. The whole correction (S1, S2a, S2b and composition) is one acceptance batch; no leaf is accepted before fresh non-author Astra xhigh and Sol6.1/max review of the composed revision. Fresh Opus experience verification follows before M2.

## Coordinator reconciliation

Root read the complete458-line advice and current call sites. It changes no production. The clean author worktree has only its assigned document. Claude Opus5.5/high selection is confirmed; there is no independent effective-effort readout. The consultant acknowledges31 verified prior payloads plus an invalid manifest self-hash, no retained browser-process ownership receipt, and the later pointer-lock acquisition recorded in cleanup. No new browser was used; those historical limits remain.

Root reran the inspected cradle probe against compiled unchanged root source in `/tmp/siltwake-opus-stage1-consult-root/`. At y−0.9 with the current3.6m proxy, tested centred x19.5–20.5 enters the cradle; tested off-centre positions contact its rail ends at z≈−14.4. This is a bounded sampled geometry result, not proof of docking or an exact continuous pass interval. A separate180-step `stepGame` probe shows sustained off-centre requested travel of **0.0044586/0.0118896/0.0163482 m per step** for quiet/cruise/boost after existing collision damping. Opus's proposed0.02m threshold would count only1/3/4 initial steps, never0.5s continuously. Root therefore accepts the measured cue but replaces that threshold with1e−5m and strict input/contact gates. In the centred run, later shore-floor stopping has no measured solid shortfall and must not be described as a rail contact. Receipts: `cradle-window-probe.json`, `contact-probe.{mjs,json}` in that root temp directory.

Decisions:

1. **Keep one compact action-result surface below the prompt.** Add optional `summary` to the existing `NoticeOptions` so the typed metadata survives the existing `SessionEvents`/GameView/HudView signature; adding it only to a GameEvent variant is insufficient. Full `message` remains available for panel/narrative feedback. Use actual operation results, never parse message text or infer transactions from rendered UI. No hard48-character cap or two-line clamp that hides an actionable refusal. A short result may wrap; persistent errors and narrative information must remain available.
2. **Collection lore remains in the notebook.** Do not add a first-collection toast/history flag. Short collection receipts use exact quantity, item and actual destination/capacity; failed/tending-only operations cannot announce a pickup. Repeated identical successful inputs still get feedback. Preserve sound once per actual action; an explicit notice must not accidentally suppress its existing sound or double it.
3. **Keep shared aim authority and separate preview.** `<4m` E/Q selection is unchanged; `4≤distance<8m` preview is presentation-only and never shadows an executable target. Unknown evidence/records get generic “Move closer”; known/source names may appear. This resolves the advice's conflicting P1 named-unknown example. Keep LOS, own-host ignore, tie rules and opening/pilot/interior gates. No remote knowledge.
4. **Rename the panel Cargo, keep container names.** Put useful Here actions before compact carried rows, then other holds/Power/Elsewhere. Keep native disclosures and semantic focus/storage intent. Reduce module text to one tradeoff line. An unavailable control must keep its useful reason. Do not use `aria-disabled=true` on a control that still submits a command: unavailable actions should not submit, with adjacent accessible reasons and preserved focus; the sim independently guards stale/racing commands. Native disabled or a focusable aria-disabled control with activation suppressed is acceptable. The retained refit must expose Store/Fit without scrolling at960×600.
5. **Deduplicate only genuinely covered hazard prose.** Active typed contexts come from the same banner construction. A stale previous-frame context must not suppress a newly relevant message without a current banner. Preserve persistence errors, recovery information, Calls fading and pulse cost/availability. The dial is explicitly horizontal bearing with a separate elevation marker, not a claim that the old source math was wrong.
6. **Service information uses shared exact rules.** Derive code/message from one authoritative check, keeping service's current branch order and mutations. Show service support in the piloted Dart even when fully serviced: “Service here · Tab” or a compact equivalent tells the returning player docking is unnecessary. “Patch hull first” applies only at a supported site after local-access rules. A fully serviced panel row may show state without an active button; do not change the valid command into a refusal.
7. **Include measured Dart forward obstruction.** No world/geometry/velocity change. Observe current sweeps once. Only active positive forward intent with negligible strafe, powered/enabled Dart and forward-moving horizontal displacement qualifies. At the HUD consumer, require requested>1e−5m, actual≤10% requested and measured solid shortfall≥80% of the lost travel for0.5 active seconds. Missing samples/progress/boundary/input release/actor/session/pause reset it. No generic speed-zero detector, passive inertia, reverse/strafe cue, terrain-floor claim or auto-docking. The existing ascent cue wins if both apply. Exact signal contract is in S1.
8. **Readable, stable UI.** Use at least12px for actionable secondary text/keys at960 and1280; allow11px only for non-action uppercase labels, not warnings/reasons. Keep stable toolbar and capture/fallback affordance. Lay out interaction/result/look and alert surfaces without overlap; do not move persistence errors inside a HUD ancestor hidden by opening/menu states. One contextual controls hint. If repeated-message live-region updates use async callbacks, cancel/version them on replacement/reset/dispose; no delayed stale announcement.
9. **Crafting reason codes preserve command precedence.** Include completed and clearance explicitly, not one opaque “other”. Existing Dart ownership is live state independent of which refusal wins first (site may precede duplicate hull); presentation must not reorder command validation to obtain its desired group. A current Dart stays rebuildable after salvage. Never call an occupied/moving/disabled hull “in cradle” solely because it is within service range.
10. **Remove panel echo notices without fallback leaks.** Both executeCommand and stepGame must treat a validated interaction-panel event as its response; suppress their generic stale-feedback fallback for that action. Do not mutate/erase saved feedback just to control a toast. Keep first-read/discovery/journal content and existing focus policy.
11. **Copy stays narrow.** “Cockpit side”, concise trim result/next step, no duplicate opening key instructions, no inaccurate pause subtitle or seated0m distance. Preserve captions, notebook voice, personal-log guidance and recovery/save warnings. Escape-to-resume, automatic toolbar fading and fixture-menu redesign remain deferred.
12. **No further stage1 scope expansion.** M2 retains depth contrast, near-field motion cues, cockpit balance and visible ecology in its benchmark region. Preserve the full fleet/world/campaign obligations. None of these UI refinements proves human feel, audible mix, duration or consumer-GPU performance.

## Ownership and order

- **S1: Sol6.1/max simulation presentation data and queries**, [exact assignment](POLISH-1-EXPERIENCE-S1.md). Root inspects its return and freezes implemented exports before dependent worktrees. No UI or browser work.
- **S2a: Sol6.1/max HUD/notices/cue/app composition**, after S1 integration. Expected own paths `src/ui/{notices,hud,view}.ts`, `src/ui/hud.css`, `src/render/{targetCue,renderer}.ts`, `src/runtime/app.ts`, bounded tests/report. Owns public GameView/HudView wiring; no panel author edits these.
- **S2b: Sol6.1/max cargo/fabrication panels**, parallel with S2a only after S1 is inspected. Expected own paths `src/ui/{panels.ts,panels.css}`, preparation tests/report. Existing panel notify API stays. No view/main/app/CSS overlap. Root supplies a frozen panel-to-view seam; no peer polling or waiting.

S2 ownership is a plan, not an active assignment. TASKS records actual dispatch. Root verifies the combined960/1280 layouts, meaningful authored tests, original earned-save imports and P1–P8 ordinary/labelled diagnostics from the advice with the corrections above. In P2 either use a separately staged full hold or enough paid collections; do not claim the second four-unit pickup necessarily refuses. Compare actual navigation/scroll/commands/refusals/site legs, not a static height estimate. Keep original source attribution and browser limits. Then fresh paired acceptance and Opus verification close stage1.
